coverageNotes: Uses sample-01 unchanged. Measures optional-nullable field composition only; independent construction of the other two source fields and patch/unset behavior remain uncovered.

questions.context:
Using Convex SDK 1.44.0, an `optionals` table has a `maybe_nullable` field. The field may be omitted, set to `null`, or set to a string. Other values must be rejected.

`v` is imported from `convex/values`.
questions.question: Which field validator allows exactly those possibilities?

options.rationale: The nullable union still requires field presence and rejects omission.
The optional string allows omission but rejects null.
An optional union member does not make the containing field optional. This expression is also statically rejected.
The outer optional allows omission; the inner union allows string or null.
